item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
Issued at 01:05 PM 21 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #CamarinesSur(Presentacion, Caramoan, Garchitorena), #OrientalMindoro(Pinamalayan, Gloria, Bansud and Bongabong) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
